name: Tidepool Tumbler Hollows
introDiscord: The Lunar Current spills into a maze of tidal pools carved through smooth coral. Water curls through the hollows in impossible loops, bubbles drift upstream, and something round goes tumbling past an opening before vanishing around the bend.
introTwitch: The Lunar Current spills into a maze of tidal pools carved through smooth coral. Water curls through the hollows in impossible loops, bubbles drift upstream, and something round goes tumbling past an opening before vanishing around the bend.

ripplegate-shelf.prompt: Perfect rings ripple across a chamber of smooth reefstone, even though nothing has disturbed the water. A shell drifts past you, disappears into one current, then floats past again from the opposite direction. Three submerged passages curve away from the looping pool.

left.message: A round shape shoots through the current, loops around the chamber, and comes flying past you a second time. On its third lap, a Tidepool Tumbler finally notices you, skids through the water, and immediately changes course in your direction.

right.message: A moon-shell coffer spins lazily in the center of a tiny whirlpool. Every time you reach for it, the current carries it around the pool and back to exactly where it started. After several increasingly personal attempts, you finally catch it and uncover Star Candies inside.

forward.message: Beneath a little shelter wedged safely outside the looping current, you find clean bandages and one of Shizuki's medicinal flasks. A note is tied around the bottle: "Drink before the current notices you are tired. I don't know what happens if it notices. I didn't wait to find out."
forward.fullHpMessage: Shizuki's medicinal flask remains tucked safely outside the current. You're already at full health, so whatever happens when the water "notices you're tired" can remain an unanswered question.

turning-pool.prompt: The passage empties into a perfectly circular pool where the current turns endlessly without wind or tide. Shells, leaves, and several extremely dizzy-looking fish orbit the center while three shadowed openings wait around the edge.

left.message: A tiny Fae offering vessel circles the pool again... and again... and again. You wait for it to pass and carefully scoop it out of the current. Inside are Star Candies and a little carved symbol that looks suspiciously like someone laughing.

right.message: A perfectly calm little tidepool sits beside the spinning current. Beneath a spiral shell, you find one Berry anchored with a piece of string and a note from Shizuki: "Never trust water that looks polite." The tidepool immediately produces one completely innocent bubble. Suspicious.

forward.message: A Tidepool Tumbler rockets out of one opening, circles the entire pool twice, vanishes down another passage, and somehow returns directly behind you. It looks extremely proud of this maneuver. Then it charges.

hollowwater-bend.prompt: Deep inside the hollows, the ceiling drops low over pale blue water. Foam drifts upward instead of toward the surface, and three currents disappear beneath coral bends before somehow returning from directions that shouldn't connect.

left.message: Moonlight slips through a crack in the coral and reveals one of Shizuki's old sleeping spots tucked safely above the current. Beside the bedroll is a restorative bottle labeled: "I tested this on myself first. Mostly. Glimmer watched, which probably counts as supervision."
left.fullHpMessage: The restorative bottle remains beside Shizuki's old sleeping spot. At full health, you have no reason to investigate what "mostly tested" means. A rare victory.

right.message: The foam suddenly starts moving against the current. A Tidepool Tumbler bursts through it, rolls through a full loop of water, and comes flying back toward you like this was absolutely the plan.

forward.message: Behind a curtain of upward-drifting foam, you uncover an old Moonkeeper cache sealed into the reefstone. The lock clicks open when moonlight touches it, revealing Star Candies untouched by the looping currents. Apparently somebody around here understood waterproof storage.

boss-antechamber.name: Primeval Tidewell
boss-antechamber.prompt: The final channel opens into a vast circular tidewell. For the first time since entering the hollows, the water is completely still. No looping currents. No drifting foam. No tumbling shells. At the center, something enormous rests beneath the glass-smooth surface.

bossPromptDiscord:
A single ripple crosses the Primeval Tidewell.

Then another.

The still water begins turning in one enormous circle as something beneath the surface rolls with the current. Whatever taught the smaller Tidepool Tumblers how to move through these hollows is waking up.

Use /yes to approach or /no to back away while the water is still giving you the option.
bossPromptTwitch:
A single ripple crosses the Primeval Tidewell.

Then another.

The still water begins turning in one enormous circle as something beneath the surface rolls with the current. Whatever taught the smaller Tidepool Tumblers how to move through these hollows is waking up.

Use !yes to approach or !no to back away while the water is still giving you the option.
bossRetreatText: You back away from the Primeval Tidewell. The enormous current slows behind you until the surface becomes perfectly still again. Somehow, that is not more reassuring.

boss.revealText: The entire tidewell suddenly turns. Water climbs the walls in a spiraling ring as an enormous shape rolls up from the depths. With a crash of foam and moonlit spray, the Tidepool Tumbler Ancient surges into view!

completionText: The Tidepool Tumbler Ancient gives one final spin before sinking peacefully beneath the tidewell. The enormous current loosens, and throughout the hollows the looping waters settle into gentler circles. Somewhere behind you, a smaller Tumbler shoots through a current, misses its turn, and tumbles straight into a patch of foam. Another route through Moonlit Reef opens ahead.
